messages:
marta: quick flag: albatross-v1 int8 mirror canary showing elevated funcall parse failures vs fp16 baseline (~2.5% vs 0.09%). First spike seen 09:15 UTC.
jon: same prompts/config as onboarding mirror? any small sample?
marta: yes, identical set. failing tail from a streaming run below:
```
Assistant: {"action":"open_case","args":{"title":"Save error on mobile", "priority":"p1",},
```
jon: trailing comma + abrupt cutoff 9 looks like truncated emission.
raj: could be a tokenization/kvcache boundary issue specific to albatross int8 kernels. we saw a whisper of this pattern in a microbench but not this magnitude.
tara: streaming vs non-streaming split? and average prompt length?
marta: primarily streaming: stream=true for ~85% of canary traffic. avg prompt ~1300 tokens. non-streaming runs show ~0.7% failures (still > baseline).
ben: did you try resetting kv between mirrored requests or forcing deterministic decode?
ml-onboard: not yet. I'll run controlled probes. propose matrix: reset_kv true/false x stream true/false x kernel_variant int8A/int8B x temp 0.0/0.6. collect last-48 tokens and token ids.
raj: also capture raw byte hex dump for the tail in case control chars or 0x00 appear. if it's a decoding artifact that helps.
jon: add a probe with strict_schema=false for diagnostics to measure how many failures are repairable by a relaxed decoder.
ben: mitigation ideas (short): 1) single automatic retry with 3 attempts and backoff 150ms, 2) json-repair postprocess applied and logged, 3) fallback to fp16 route if still >1% failures, 4) consider EOS-biasing in int8 kernel longer-term.
infra-bot: verified no proxy truncation on canary path.
ci-bot: job created: canary/albatross-int8/parse-tail-scan (id: job-20260321-314)
ml-onboard: kicked off job-20260321-314 with matrix above for 15k samples. ETA initial results ~4h. will attach CSV with failure types: trailing-comma, unclosed-brace, control-garbage, partial-array, non-json-suffix.
tara: please also tag any cases where repair modifies semantic fields (e.g., repairs that change numeric values) so we can estimate safe repair rate.
raj: if many failures share the same final token-ids pattern we may instrument decode logits for the final 8 tokens to inspect noise floor.
jon: small local repro idea: run high-length prompt fuzz with int8 kernel and force early stop token to see if emission distribution shifts with kv alignment.
marta: good. when job posts top failing prompts paste them here. if >1% user-visible funcall failures we hold rollout and route to fp16 fallback.
ml-onboard: job-20260321-314 status: running -> will update with summary CSV and top-10 failing prompts + token dumps.
ben: note cost impact of retries; ensure token-cost cap per-request before fallback.
marta: thanks all. I'll draft short decision tree for rollback once the CSV is in.
ci-bot: job-20260321-314 status: queued -> running
